the main indications for upper gastrointestinal endoscopy were abdominal pain and bleeding, while the main endoscopic findings were gastritis, hiatus hernia, gastric erosions and oesophageal varies.

upper gastrointestinal endoscopy is an important tool in the diagnosis and management of gastrointestinal disorders in children in developing countries.

upper gastrointestinal endoscopy should be considered as an integral part of the diagnostic work-up of children presenting with recurrent abdominal pain and upper gastrointestinal bleeding.
